The learned DAG further submits that after the notification is published, the right, title and interest of the owners are extinguished and any subsequent preparation of Khatian and payment or rent does not improve the position of the original owners in respect of the acquired land. In support of his contention, he refers to the decision in the cases or Bangladesh Sangbadpatra Parishad (BSP) vs Bangladesh, 43 DLR (AD) 126 and Bangladesh vs Nawab Abdul Malik Jute Mills Ltd. 60 DLR (AD)7.
